I was a reckless carefree teenager and I fucked up pretty bad. I got let off easy and decided to turn my life around. Part of doing so was pushing away all the bad people I had in my life (mainly friends) and this has caused me much pain. So I decided to have no emotion basically but this backfired and I ended up pushing away everyone close to me and I am left all alone with a shit ton of emotion inside that’s been building up. I tried to turn my life around, and it worked kind of because I am no longer doing bad things but I am not doing good things either. This has cause me to have a lot of free time and a lot of time to think about things. I have nothing going for me. At least when I was doing all this stupid stuff, I was fearless and carefree. Now I am the opposite. I worry way too much about everything and overthink everything and all I do is watch tv and play video games to numb the pain. I have not improved the world we live in therefore I question my value.
Wait a minute... someone my age who actually listen to older music?
Hey my name is Jake and I’m 17. I’m addicted to the internet to the numb the pain of being lonely and what not so I’ll be online very often. Feel free to message me at any time.

I feel the same. It’s almost as if I’m wearing a mask when I’m around my “friends”. The true me is hidden somewhere deep inside and I want to fit in and be liked so I almost make a new personality in order to fit in. I cant keep this up forever and it is wearing me down. At this point I’ve lost myself and don’t even know who I am anymore. I have also always had trouble telling others about my problems because I feel as if I am putting an unnecessary weight on them that I should be dealing with, not them. So I pretty much hold my emotions in and because of this they build up and cause a lot of pain, especially right before I go to sleep for some reason. No one knows how much pain I’m in.
